## Install

**Android:** download the `.apk`, open it, and allow installing from this source when asked.

**macOS:** open the `.dmg` and drag Lt to Applications. The app isn't notarized yet, so the first time macOS blocks it: open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway**. Or run `xattr -cr /Applications/Lt.app` in Terminal.

**Windows:** unzip and run `lt.exe`. If SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC", click **More info → Run anyway**.

You'll need your own OpenAI API key, entered in Settings.
